sentence: This project studies drugs and metabolites in biological samples using liquid chromatography and tandem mass spectrometry.
This project builds a mouse model exposed to infections and vaccinations like those humans encounter, to study the immune response against tumors.
This project studies how adults switch between nicotine pouches and cigarettes and how these changes affect health.
This project tries to find out which genetic variants link air pollution to asthma.
This project tries to find out how a matricellular protein helps the intestinal epithelium repair and regenerate after injury.
This project studies whether using turmeric, curcumin and ginseng is linked to circulating metabolites and cardiometabolic biomarkers in adults.
This project uses human pluripotent stem cells to make retinal cells and organoids for testing the safety of genome editing treatments.
This project builds methods that use mass spectrometry to study the higher order structure of proteins in complex model systems.
This project studies whether combinations of drugs that target malignant hematopoietic stem cells can reduce cancer stem cells in patients with myelofibrosis.
This project helps cancer investigators analyze genomic data by providing high performance computing and storage.
This project develops photon counting CT imaging in small animal models to detect intracranial aneurysm growth and tests whether aspirin reduces it.
This project builds a deep learning model that reads neuroimages to find covert cerebrovascular disease and predict stroke and dementia.
This project measures many proteins at once and how quickly they turn over, using mass spectrometry and deuterium oxide labeling.
This project tests whether electric fields can help retinal ganglion cell axons regenerate to restore optic nerve function.
This project builds on earlier work to support rheumatology research with a bioinformatics core that helps describe patient cohorts better.
This project supports mouse studies by breeding and making transgenic mice and analyzing transcriptome data.
This project studies the atomic details of the respiratory syncytial virus polymerase to understand how the virus makes RNA.
This project studies a set of genes that may drive relapse and resistance to chemotherapy in acute myelogenous leukemia.
